description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'fsck' functionality related to buffers without NUL termination in Git objects. It defines functions to reset test state, add objects, and check for buffer overrun protection, then executes various tests to ensure the integrity of the buffer handling in Git's 'hash-object' command.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new line to the base file with specified content.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a buffer overrun check on a specific object type with provided content.
